subject: general
question: Which is a specialised excretory cell found in Platyhelminthes that acts like a kidney, removing waste material through filtration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flame cell**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Protonephridia is part of the excretory system of Platyhelminthes.
 
• It is also known as the Flame cell.
 
• An example of the phylum Platyhelminthes is Flatworm.
 
• Platyhelminthes are one of the phyla among all other Non-chordates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Platyhelminthes: Platy means flat and Helminthes means worms.
 
 
• They are basically Flatworms.
 
• They are triploblastic in nature.
 
• They live on land or in freshwater.
 
• They have only one opening in the Alimentary canal.
 
• The anus is absent.
 
• They excrete through Flame cells.
 
• Eg: Taenia, Planaria.
